mode.title: What to collect
mode.description: Snapshots of a page over time, the closest snapshot to a given date, or every unique URL the archive knows for a site.
enumTitles: All archived URLs of a site

urls.title: URLs or domains
urls.description: A page URL (example.com/pricing) or a domain (example.com). Use 'Match' to include subpaths or subdomains.

matchType.title: Match
matchType.description: Exact URL, everything under a path prefix, a whole host, or a domain with all subdomains. Defaults: exact for snapshots, domain for 'All archived URLs'.

closestTo.title: Closest to (mode: closest)
closestTo.description: Date to approach, e.g. 2020-06-15. Returns the nearest capture for each URL.

collapse.title: One snapshot per (mode: snapshots)
collapse.description: Thin out the timeline: keep one snapshot per hour, day, month or year, or only snapshots whose content changed.

statusFilter.title: HTTP status
statusFilter.description: Only captures with this status code (200, 301, 404...). Type 'any' to keep everything.

mimeType.title: MIME type
mimeType.description: Optional filter, e.g. text/html, application/pdf, image/png.

maxItems.title: Max results per URL
maxItems.description: Maximum snapshots (or URLs) for each entry. You are charged per result.
